main_body: marble column with capital, cylindrical shaft, and base
top_band: light grey and white top surface of the capital at rows 9-11 (3 rows tall), followed by a bright white front-edge line at row 12
evidence: Reading down the middle column from row 8: row 8 is the top outline; rows 9-11 form a 3px tall foreshortened light-grey top band on the capital with rounded upper corners; row 12 is a distinct 1px pure-white front edge highlight; rows 13-15 are the shaded front face of the capital; rows 16-17 show an overhang shadow where the shaft is recessed under the capital; rows 17-39 form the cylindrical shaft and rows 40-47 the stepped base.

style.evidence: While the column uses a 6-step grey ramp for cylindrical shading, rows 19-37 of the shaft are a purely mechanical 19-row vertical extrusion of an identical 1px gradient with no marble veining, fluting, stone grain, or drum joints, and the base (rows 41-46) is a direct copy-paste of the capital (rows 9-14) down to the harsh 1px white stripe, giving it a smooth plastic/metallic look compared to the richly textured Beodeul reference props.
